test_cases.description: Clearly matching user for PM-JAY via urban occupation category (pre-screen only, not a guaranteed DB match).
test_cases.reason: Occupation matches an urban PM-JAY inclusion category (R_PMJAY_002), but final PASS requires the SECC 2011 database match (R_PMJAY_001), which cannot be computed from profile fields alone.

test_cases.description: Clearly non-matching user for Vay Vandana due to age.
test_cases.reason: Age 45 does not meet the R_VAY_001 requirement of >=70 years.

test_cases.description: Missing income for a scheme that requires an income check (CMCHIS).
test_cases.reason: R_CMCHIS_003 unknown_behavior is BLOCK_DETERMINISTIC_RESULT_SHOW_NEEDS_VERIFICATION; missing income compounds with the rule's inherent unverified threshold, so result must be UNKNOWN/NEEDS_VERIFICATION, never a computed PASS or FAIL.

test_cases.description: Unknown existing coverage for Vay Vandana (should not default to 'no').
test_cases.reason: unknown_behavior for R_VAY_003 explicitly forbids assuming 'no existing coverage'; the system must ask/flag rather than silently proceeding as if no conflicting scheme exists.

test_cases.description: Multiple matching schemes: a 72-year-old ESI-covered factory worker in Chennai.

expected_results.note: Age 70+ met; ESI coverage explicitly does not block Vay Vandana per R_VAY_004.
Wage within ceiling, establishment size sufficient, payroll employee.

test_cases.reason: Demonstrates that a person can be flagged as a likely match for more than one scheme simultaneously; the engine should return a ranked/combined list, not force a single result.

test_cases.description: No matching scheme: a 40-year-old self-employed person in Delhi earning well above all thresholds, not in the PM-JAY database, no CGHS category.
test_cases.reason: Demonstrates a realistic 'no scheme matched' outcome across all 5 researched schemes for this profile; note PM-JAY's true result still technically needs official DB confirmation even though prescreen strongly suggests non-inclusion.

test_cases.description: Boundary value test: ESI wage exactly at the Rs 21,000 ceiling.

expected_results.note: Operator is less_than_or_equal, so exactly 21000 should PASS.

test_cases.reason: Tests the inclusive boundary specified by the 'less_than_or_equal' operator in R_ESIC_001.

test_cases.description: Missing state for a state-specific scheme (CMCHIS).
test_cases.reason: unknown_behavior for R_CMCHIS_001 is TREAT_AS_UNKNOWN; the engine must not assume the user is NOT a Tamil Nadu resident just because state was left blank.

test_cases.description: Missing occupation for PM-JAY urban-category pre-screen.
test_cases.reason: unknown_behavior for R_PMJAY_002 is TREAT_AS_UNKNOWN; missing occupation should not be treated as a fail on this pre-screen rule.

test_cases.description: Beneficiary-database verification required scenario for PM-JAY.

expected_results.note: ST household matches D5 rural deprivation criterion.

test_cases.reason: Even a strong pre-screen match (SC/ST household under D5) must be presented to the user as 'likely eligible, please verify at beneficiary.nha.gov.in' rather than a final confirmed PASS, per the database_match design of R_PMJAY_001.
